name: Governed Scale Disclosure Assurance and Restatement Control
objective: Control disclosure assurance, material change, correction, restatement and successor-record workflows so published climate/ESG information remains reproducible, scope-bound and historically traceable.
restatement_rules: Never overwrite historical evidence or published metric records.
Every material correction receives a reason, affected scope, affected period, methodology/version and authorizing review.
Successor records link to predecessor records and preserve the original digest/reference.
A restatement must identify whether the change affects value, boundary, method, source, evidence interpretation or disclosure wording.
Reauthorization is required when a material change alters an already authorized disclosure.
disclosure_invariants: published value must equal authorized value
published scope must equal reviewed scope
published period must equal reviewed period
limitations and material exceptions remain attached
successor records cannot erase predecessor history
fail_closed: scope or period differs from assurance population
public/investor surface diverges from authorized record
restatement presented as new measurement without provenance
